t: The Fortress Trade 2.5" Angled Sash Paint Brush is an essential painting tool for professionals, designed for precise cutting-in around intricate fixtures, trim, and window frames. Its durable synthetic bristles and solid, round tapered filaments provide excellent control and a superb paint load capacity, making it ideal for detailed work. Mixed filaments are incorporated to effectively reduce tramlines, ensuring a consistently smooth finish across all paint types. Featuring a rust-resistant stainless steel ferrule and a comfortable beavertail handle, this brush offers reliability and comfort during extended use. It is also quick and easy to clean, enhancing efficiency on site.
